contract_question: Can the immediate local tick add a compiling non-tautological Lean object that lowers or pays part of shard B from existing L3/CKN/residual-fresh primitives without a strictness oracle or pre-GNN mutation?
rationale_short: A compiling B-side lowering object is feasible, but fully paying a numeric field may require a small new estimate lemma because many existing primitives are propositional.
